name: Quinoa-Spinach Salad with Shrimp, Strawberries, Basil, Feta & Almonds

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 yellow bell peppers
1 ½ (454 g) pkgs strawberries
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallots into half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise; add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Add feta to the bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the cooked quinoa to a large baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add shrimp and season with salt and pepper; cook until opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add cooled quinoa to the bowl with the dressing and salad fixings; gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide spinach between plates; top with quinoa salad, shrimp, almonds, and reserved basil. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
